remarks: Step into this beautifully maintained first-floor apartment in a classic Victorian home, where charm meets modern comfort. This bright and spacious unit features an updated bathroom, a large eat-in kitchen, and generously sized rooms filled with natural light. Enjoy year-round comfort thanks to energy-efficient windows and ceiling fans. The apartment offers both front and back porches-perfect for relaxing mornings or quiet evenings-as well as access to a nicely kept yard. Additional perks include basement storage and a washer/dryer hookup for added convenience. With a thoughtful blend of historic character and modern updates, this inviting space is ready to welcome you home.
